Improve ONLY the clothing and footwear of image 1 below the chin, retaining its exact head, pose, overall body proportions, scale, canvas framing and location. This is a production master for a customizable game character, so the anatomy must be completely coherent: both trouser legs connect naturally to a single pair of ankles and both shoes are centered underneath those ankles. Same neutral standing pose, slight three-quarter attitude, arms relaxed and cream cartoon gloves. The two feet remain planted on the same baseline, same stance, no twisted feet or extra collars. Outfit: a warm OCHRE #c89536 short-sleeved T-shirt with a neat ribbed collar, one small chest pocket, subtle double hems and natural sparse ink folds; TEAL #087f7c well-cut relaxed jeans with two believable front pockets, fly seam and neat turned-up cuffs; matching OCHRE #c89536 sturdy rounded low work shoes with distinct leather panels, three simple lace rows, cream soles and subtle outsole edge. Shoe openings must align precisely with trouser leg centers, and trousers sit just over the shoe collar without exposed floating socks. Use warm rosy PEACH #e8a08d only for the bare forearms, keep gloves and soles ivory cream. Keep the Sylvain 1930s cartoon language: confident thick black outlines, clean flat colors, sparse regular halftone shadows, round flowing silhouette, balanced detail visible in a game avatar, no realistic rendering, no gradients, no tiny fussy textures. Full exact same character in exact same frame, generous margins preserved, true transparent background, no floor shadow, no text, no props. This should be polished coherent clothing on one body, not an assembly of loose cutouts.
